title: 第二十二章夜神花花粉第二十三章破损法宝
slug: 凡人修仙我能变废为宝
lines: “此处便是我们丹烛观的灵植园了。”
几日后，清虚老道把江离带到了灵植园。
院子的中心位置，有一口井，四周种植的全都是各色灵植。
除了少部分江离认识的灵植之外，大部分灵植江离都不认识。
一眼扫过，江离瞳孔微微一缩。
“七星草，落生梨，阳金葫芦……”
这些，都是炼制黄庭丹所需的材料。
一一辨认过后，江离发现，清虚老道的灵植园中，竟有大部分炼制黄庭丹所需的灵植。
除了三味主药，以及少部分的辅药。
若是有机会从中收集一些，便可着手准备炼制黄庭丹了。
“这一小块灵田，便是你接下来需要照看的夜神花了。”
清虚老道指着一块灵田说道。
“这几日，你需要熟悉一下如何照顾这些灵植。三日后，夜神花成熟，你需要采集其花粉，研磨成粉，交给我。”
“记住！夜神花只会在夜间开放，花期也仅有半个时辰。花开过后，夜神花便会枯萎，直接将其拔除即可。”
“在夜神花开花的这半个时辰之内，你需要将花粉统统采集下来。若是误了时辰，花粉上的灵力便会流失，变成无用之物。”
“记住了？”
江离道：“记住了。”
清虚老道满意的点点头：“夜神花的花粉采集下来之后，我会离开丹烛观一段时间。这段时间，还会有一些灵植成熟，到时候也需要你来将其采集下来，替我带到坎儿井的灵仙堂售卖。”
“下面我和你讲讲如何管理这片灵植园，听好了……”
说着，清虚老道便事无巨细的讲了起来。
一讲就是半个多时辰。
好在随着江离修为的提升，他的记忆力也有显著增强，清虚老道所讲的内容全部都被江离一一记了下来。
“你暂且留在这里熟悉熟悉吧。”
说完，清虚老道便丢下了一块玉牌，飘然而去。
清虚老道走后，江离便开始熟悉起了这片灵植园。
之前江离一直搞不懂，此地没有灵气，清虚老道是如何种植灵植的。
现在他终于明白了。
原来这丹烛观中竟有一口灵井。
灵植园中心的那口井，并非水井，而是灵井。
灵脉，分为大中小三个类型。
大型灵脉，灵气浓郁，往往都会被一些大宗门所占据。
台海宗的灵脉，便是大型灵脉。
像小月宗这种小一些的宗门，通常都会占据着中型灵脉。
content_en:
"This is the spiritual plant garden of our Danzhu Temple."
A few days later, Old Taoist Qingxu brought Jiang Li to Lingzhi Garden.
In the center of the yard, there is a well, surrounded by various spiritual plants.
Except for a few Lingzhi whom Jiang Li knew, most of them were unknown to Jiang Li.
After a quick glance, Jiang Li's pupils shrank slightly.
"This is..."
"Seven-star grass, fallen pear, Yangjin gourd..."
These are all the materials needed to refine Huang Ting Dan.
After identifying them one by one, Jiang Li discovered that Qingxu Laodao's spiritual plant garden contained most of the spiritual plants needed to refine Huang Tingdan.
In addition to the three main ingredients, there are also a small number of auxiliary ingredients.
If you have the opportunity to collect some from them, you can start preparing to refine Huang Ting Dan.
"This small piece of spiritual field is the Night God Flower that you need to take care of next."
Old Taoist Qingxu pointed at a piece of spiritual field and said.
"In the past few days, you need to become familiar with how to take care of these spiritual plants. After three days, the Night God Flower will mature. You need to collect its pollen, grind it into powder, and give it to me."
"Remember! The Night God Flower only blooms at night, and the flowering period is only half an hour. After the flowers bloom, the Night God Flower will wither, just pull it out."
"You need to collect all the pollen within half an hour of the Night God Flower blooming. If the time is delayed, the spiritual power on the pollen will be lost and become useless."
"Remember?"
Jiang Li said: "Remember."
Old Taoist Qingxu nodded with satisfaction: "After collecting the pollen from the Night God Flower, I will leave Danzhu Temple for a period of time. During this period, some spiritual plants will mature. At that time, I will also need you to collect them and bring them to the Lingxian Hall in Karez for me to sell."
"Now I will tell you how to manage this spiritual plant garden. Listen carefully..."
With that said, Old Taoist Qingxu started talking about everything in detail.
One lecture lasted more than half an hour.
Fortunately, as Jiang Li's cultivation level improved, his memory also improved significantly, and Jiang Li memorized everything that Qingxu Lao Tao said.
"You can stay here and get familiar with it for now."
After saying that, Old Taoist Qingxu dropped a jade plaque and floated away.
After Qingxu Lao Dao left, Jiang Li began to become familiar with this spiritual plant garden.
Jiang Li had never understood before that there was no spiritual energy in this place, so how could Old Taoist Qingxu grow spiritual plants.
Now he finally understands.
It turns out that there is a spiritual well in this Danzhu temple.
The well in the center of the Lingzhi Garden is not a water well, but a spiritual well.
Spiritual veins are divided into three types: large, medium and small.
Large spiritual veins with strong spiritual energy are often occupied by some large sects.
The spiritual veins of Taihai Sect are large spiritual veins.
Smaller sects like Xiaoyue Sect usually occupy medium-sized spiritual veins.
